leadText:
Francesca (Japanese: シズエ Shizue) is a Pokémon Magician and a character of the day who appeared in The Bells Are Singing!.

Francesca performs with three . One of them, wearing a green ribbon, seemed to have a little more personality than the other two, being very energetic. It loved to meet new people and would hug them. Francesca tried to use it in a against Ash's Turtwig in order to discipline it, but it was weak. Her training exercises were very difficult, even though she was dealing with small Pokémon.

After kidnapped her three Chingling, James grew fond of the Chingling wearing the green ribbon, as it reminded him of his . Later on, Francesca gained more confidence in Chingling and used it to defeat James and
